## Objective
This script is to validate the layers model (crypt vs. villi)

```{r, libraries, directories and functions, message=FALSE}
library(sf)
Sys.setenv(OGR_GEOJSON_MAX_OBJ_SIZE = 0)
library(tidyverse)
library(jsonlite)
library(purrr)
options(scipen = 999) #turn of scientific notation
library(readxl)
library(writexl)

to_box <- "~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/"

#to calculate area even if some geometries are empty
safe_area <- function(geom) {
    if (length(geom) == 0 || all(st_is_empty(geom))) {
      return(0)
    } else {
      return(as.numeric(st_area(geom)))
    }
  }

# occasionally annotations are not closed - and becomes linestrings instead of polygons. This function fixes that.
convert_linestrings_to_polygons <- function(sf_df) {
  new_geoms <- lapply(st_geometry(sf_df), function(geom) {
    geom_type <- as.character(st_geometry_type(geom))
    if (geom_type %in% c("LINESTRING", "LINESTRING Z")) {
      # Get the coordinate matrix
      coords <- st_coordinates(geom)
      # Check closure using only x and y values
      if (!all(coords[1, 1:2] == coords[nrow(coords), 1:2])) {
        coords <- rbind(coords, coords[1,])
      }
      # Drop extra dimensions (Z/M) by keeping only x and y
      coords <- coords[, 1:2, drop = FALSE]
      # Construct and return a polygon using the 2D, closed coordinates
      st_polygon(list(coords))
    } else {
      # For geometries that are not LINESTRINGs, return them unchanged
      geom
    }
  })
  
  # Replace the geometry column while preserving other attributes
  st_set_geometry(sf_df, st_sfc(new_geoms, crs = st_crs(sf_df)))
}

# Read annotation geojsons 
read_annotations_raw <- function(annotation_dir, image_names) {
  annotations <- image_names %>% 
    map_dfr(function(img) {
      message("Retreiving annotation image ", img)
      pattern <- paste0("^", img, ".*\\.geojson$")
      files <- list.files(path = annotation_dir, pattern = pattern, full.names = TRUE)
      
      if (length(files) > 0) {
        map_dfr(files, function(file) {
          st_read(file, quiet = TRUE) %>%
            st_set_crs(0) %>%
            select(classification, geometry) %>%
            # Add image_name; extract classification name from the JSON; set confidence_percentage to 100;
            # mark these rows as "annotation"
            mutate(
              image_name = img,
              classification = map_chr(classification, ~ fromJSON(.x)$name),
              confidence_percentage = 100,
              source = "annotation"
            )
        })
      } else {
        message("No files found for image: ", img)
        tibble(
          classification = character(),
          geometry = st_sfc(),
          image_name = character(),
          confidence_percentage = numeric(),
          source = character()
        )
      }
    })
  
  # Convert to an sf data frame
  annotations <- st_as_sf(annotations)
  
  # Convert any LINESTRING geometries to POLYGONs
  annotations <- convert_linestrings_to_polygons(annotations) %>%
    st_make_valid()
  
  # Group by and union geometries
  annotations_united <- annotations %>%
    group_by(image_name, classification, confidence_percentage, source) %>%
    summarise(geometry = st_union(geometry), .groups = "drop")
  
  return(annotations_united)
}





# Function to process annotations and output by ROI – crop all features to the ROI (from annotation rows with classification "roi") and compute an "empty" polygon for the parts of the ROI that have no other output.

process_roi <- function(combined_sf) {
  library(sf)
  library(dplyr)
  library(purrr)
  
  processed <- map_dfr(unique(combined_sf$image_name), function(img) {
    print(paste0("Processing annotation and ai output per roi for image ", img))
    current <- combined_sf %>% filter(image_name == img)
    
    # Extract ROI geometry from annotation rows with classification "roi"
    roi <- current %>% 
      filter(source == "annotation", classification == "roi")
    if (nrow(roi) == 0) {
      message("No ROI found for image: ", img)
      return(NULL)
    } 
    
    
    # Filter out features that do not overlap the ROI at all
    current <- current[st_intersects(current, roi, sparse = FALSE), ]
    
    # Crop every feature to the ROI area
    cropped <- current %>% 
      mutate(geometry = st_intersection(geometry, roi)) %>%
      filter(!st_is_empty(geometry))
    
    # For generating the empty observation, we create two sets:
    # 1. For source "annotation": the ROI area not covered by any annotation output (excluding the ROI itself)
    anno_nonroi <- cropped %>% filter(source == "annotation", classification != "roi")
    if (nrow(anno_nonroi) > 0) {
      union_anno <- st_union(anno_nonroi$geometry)
      empty_geom_annotation <- st_difference(roi, union_anno)
      } else {
        empty_geom_annotation <- roi
        }
    
    # 2. For source "ai": the ROI area not covered by any AI output
    ai_nonroi <- cropped %>% filter(source == "ai")
    if (nrow(ai_nonroi) > 0) {
      union_ai <- st_union(ai_nonroi$geometry)
      empty_geom_ai <- st_difference(roi, union_ai)
      } else {
        empty_geom_ai <- roi
        }
    
    # Create empty sf objects if the difference is nonempty.
    if (!is.null(empty_geom_annotation) && nrow(empty_geom_annotation) > 0 &&
        !st_is_empty(empty_geom_annotation)) {
      empty_annotation <- st_sf(
        image_name = img,
        classification = "empty",
        confidence_percentage = 100,
        source = "annotation",
        geometry = empty_geom_annotation$geometry
        )
      cropped <- bind_rows(cropped, empty_annotation)
      }
    
    if (!is.null(empty_geom_ai) && nrow(empty_geom_ai) > 0 &&
        !st_is_empty(empty_geom_ai)) {
      empty_ai <- st_sf(
        image_name = img,
        classification = "empty",
        confidence_percentage = 100,
        source = "ai",
        geometry = empty_geom_ai$geometry
        )
      cropped <- bind_rows(cropped, empty_ai)
    }
  
      # Explicitly return the cropped dataframe
    return(cropped)
  })
}

#Adds area and normalizes to roi size
process_val_sf <- function(val_sf) {
  # Read the sf data frame, set the CRS, and compute area in pixels squared
  sf_df <- val_sf %>%
    mutate(area_px2 = as.numeric(st_area(.)))
  
  # Helper function to get the mode of a vector
  get_mode <- function(v) {
    uniqv <- unique(v)
    uniqv[which.max(tabulate(match(v, uniqv)))]
  }
  
  # Calculate the mode of area_px2 for geometries with classification "roi"
  roi_area_mode <- sf_df %>%
    filter(classification == "roi") %>%
    pull(area_px2) %>%
    get_mode()
  
  # Add the normalized area and filter out any zero values
  sf_df <- sf_df %>%
    mutate(normalized_area = round(area_px2 / roi_area_mode, 3)) %>%
    filter(normalized_area != 0) %>%
    select(image_name:area_px2, normalized_area, geometry)
  
  return(sf_df)
}

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)

explore_composition<- function(val_sf, class_palette) {
  
  # Summarize data: Compute total area per source and classification
  val_sf_summary <- val_sf %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    group_by(source, classification) %>%
    summarise(total_area = sum(normalized_area, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    ungroup()

  # Compute percentage of total area for each classification within each source
  val_sf_summary <- val_sf_summary %>%
    group_by(source) %>%
    mutate(percentage = (total_area / sum(total_area)) * 100) %>%
    arrange(source, desc(percentage)) %>%  # Arrange so the largest is first
    ungroup()

  # Reverse the stacking order: Ensure largest classification is at the top
  val_sf_summary <- val_sf_summary %>%
    group_by(source) %>%
    mutate(classification = factor(classification, levels = classification[order(percentage)])) %>%
    ungroup()

  # Rename `source` labels for readability
  val_sf_summary <- val_sf_summary %>%
    mutate(source = case_when(
      source == "ai" ~ "AI output",
      source == "annotation" ~ "Validation annotation",
      TRUE ~ source  # Keep other values unchanged
    ))

  # Create stacked bar plot
  p <- ggplot(val_sf_summary, aes(x = source, y = percentage, fill = classification)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack") +  # Stacked bar chart
    scale_fill_manual(values = class_palette) +  # Custom color palette
    labs(x = "", y = "", fill = "Classification") +
    theme_bw(base_family = "Arial") +  # Set base font to Arial
    theme(text = element_text(size = 9, family = "Arial"))  # Set font size 9

  return(list(summary = val_sf_summary, plot = p))  # Return the plot
}



# Define function
explore_ai_confidence <- function(sf_val, confidence_palette) {
  
  # Filter AI source 
  data <- sf_val %>%
    filter(source == "ai")
  
  # Create confidence bins (10% intervals)
  data$confidence_bin <- cut(data$confidence_percentage,
                             breaks = seq(0, 100, by = 1),
                             include.lowest = TRUE,
                             right = FALSE,
                             labels = paste(seq(0, 99, by = 1), seq(1, 100, by = 1), sep = "-"))

  # Summarize total area per classification and confidence_bin
  df_plot <- data %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    group_by(classification, confidence_bin) %>%
    summarise(total_area = sum(normalized_area, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    group_by(classification) %>%
    mutate(percent_area = total_area / sum(total_area) * 100) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  # Reorder confidence_bin within each classification so the largest is at the bottom
  df_plot <- df_plot %>%
    arrange(classification, desc(percent_area)) %>%
    mutate(confidence_bin = factor(confidence_bin, levels = paste(seq(0, 99, by = 1), seq(1, 100, by = 1), sep = "-"))) 

  # Generate the stacked bar plot
  p <- ggplot(df_plot, aes(x = classification, y = percent_area, fill = confidence_bin)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(scale = 1)) +  # Format as percentage
    scale_fill_manual(values = confidence_palette) +  # Apply custom colors
    labs(x = "", y = "Percentage of total area", fill = "AI confidence %") +
    theme_bw(base_family = "Arial") +  # Set base font to Arial
    theme(
      text = element_text(size = 9, family = "Arial"),  # Set font size 9
      legend.position = "right"
    )  # Combined into a single theme() call
  
  return(list(summary = df_plot, plot = p))  # Properly return the plot object
}


#Explore calibration by class
explore_calibration <- function(input_sf, target_class, bin_breaks, bin_labels) {
  # Load required libraries (if not already loaded)
  library(dplyr)
  library(sf)
  library(ggplot2)
  
  # Define a safe_area function to compute geometry area (or 0 if empty)
  safe_area <- function(geom) {
    if (length(geom) == 0 || all(st_is_empty(geom))) {
      return(0)
    } else {
      return(as.numeric(st_area(geom)))
    }
  }
  
  # Filter to the target class (e.g. "villi" or "crypts")
  target_df <- input_sf %>% filter(classification == target_class)
  
  # Create confidence bins.
  
  pred <- target_df %>%
    mutate(confidence_bin = cut(confidence_percentage,
                                breaks = bin_breaks,
                                include.lowest = TRUE,
                                right = FALSE,
                                labels = bin_labels))
  
  # Separate ground truth and predictions.
  gt_sf <- pred %>% filter(source == "annotation")
  pred_sf <- pred %>% filter(source == "ai")
  
  # Union all ground truth geometries into one
  gt_union <- st_union(gt_sf)
  
  # Group the prediction geometries by confidence bin and union them.
  pred_bins <- pred_sf %>%
    group_by(confidence_bin) %>%
    summarise(geometry = st_union(geometry)) %>%  # one geometry per bin
    ungroup()

  # Compute the True Positive (TP) and False Positive (FP) geometries.
  # TP: Intersection of the bin geometry with the ground truth.
  # FP: Difference between the bin geometry and the ground truth.
  pred_bins <- pred_bins %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(
      TP_geom = list(st_union(st_intersection(geometry, gt_union))),
      FP_geom = list(st_union(st_difference(geometry, gt_union)))
    ) %>%
    ungroup()

  # Calculate the area for TP and FP, and compute PPV.
  # Use a conditional check to avoid subscript out of bounds if the list element is empty.
  pred_bins <- pred_bins %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    TP_area = safe_area(TP_geom),
    FP_area = safe_area(FP_geom),
    PPV = ifelse((TP_area + FP_area) == 0, NA, TP_area / (TP_area + FP_area))
  ) 
  
  pred_bins <- pred_bins %>% 
    select(confidence_bin, TP_area, FP_area, PPV)

  # Create and return the calibration plot.
  p <- ggplot(pred_bins, aes(x = confidence_bin, y = PPV)) +
    geom_point(size = 3) +
    geom_line(aes(group = 1), linetype = "dashed") +
    labs(x = "Confidence Bin", 
         y = "Positive Predictive Value (PPV)",
         title = paste("PPV by Confidence Bin for", target_class)) +
    theme_bw(base_family = "Arial") +  # Set base font to Arial
    theme(
      text = element_text(size = 9, family = "Arial"),  # Set font size 9
      legend.position = "right"
    )
  
  return(list(summary = pred_bins, plot = p))
}

#Function to compute performance across different confidence thresholds
compute_class_metrics_thresholds <- function(sf, cls, thresholds, palette) {
  library(dplyr)
  library(sf)
  library(ggplot2)
  
 
  
  # A helper function to compute area.
  safe_area <- function(geom) {
    if (length(geom) == 0 || all(st_is_empty(geom))) {
      return(0)
    } else {
      return(as.numeric(st_area(geom)))
    }
  }
  
  # Iterate through each threshold and compute metrics.
  results <- lapply(thresholds, function(th) {
    # Ground truth (annotation) for this class.
    gt <- sf %>%
      filter(source == "annotation", classification == cls) %>%
      st_union()
    
    # Predictions (ai) for this class with the current threshold filter.
    pred <- sf %>%
      filter(source == "ai",
             classification == cls,
             confidence_percentage >= th) %>%
      st_union()
    
    # ROI geometry comes from the annotation row with classification "roi".
    roi <- sf %>%
      filter(source == "annotation", classification == "roi") %>%
      st_union()
    
    # Compute intersection (TP) and differences (FN and FP).
    TP_geom <- st_intersection(gt, pred)
    FN_geom <- st_difference(gt, pred)
    FP_geom <- st_difference(pred, gt)
    
    # TN: within the ROI, the area that is neither in gt nor in pred.
    union_gt_pred <- st_union(gt, pred)
    TN_geom <- st_difference(roi, union_gt_pred)
    
    # Compute areas.
    TP <- safe_area(TP_geom)
    FP <- safe_area(FP_geom)
    FN <- safe_area(FN_geom)
    TN <- safe_area(TN_geom)
    
    # Create a tibble of metrics including the current threshold.
    metrics <- tibble(
      threshold = th,
      TP = TP,
      FP = FP,
      FN = FN,
      TN = TN
    )
    
    # Compute additional metrics, protecting against division by zero.
    metrics <- metrics %>%
      mutate(
        sensitivity       = ifelse((TP + FN) > 0, round(100 * TP / (TP + FN), 1), NA_real_),
        specificity       = ifelse((TN + FP) > 0, round(100 * TN / (TN + FP), 1), NA_real_),
        ppv               = ifelse((TP + FP) > 0, round(100 * TP / (TP + FP), 1), NA_real_),
        npv               = ifelse((TN + FN) > 0, round(100 * TN / (TN + FN), 1), NA_real_),
        accuracy          = ifelse((TP + TN + FP + FN) > 0, round(100 * (TP + TN) / (TP + TN + FP + FN), 1), NA_real_),
        f1_score          = ifelse((ppv + sensitivity) > 0,
                               round(100 * (2 * (ppv / 100 * sensitivity / 100)) / ((ppv / 100) + (sensitivity / 100)), 1),
                               NA_real_),
        balanced_accuracy = ifelse(!is.na(sensitivity) & !is.na(specificity),
                               round((sensitivity + specificity) / 2, 1),
                               NA_real_)
  )
    
    return(metrics)
  })
  
  # Combine all results into one tibble.
  results_df <- bind_rows(results)
  
  # Calculate the False Positive Rate (FPR).
  results_df <- results_df %>% mutate(fpr = 100 - specificity)
  
  # For plotting, only include rows with non-missing sensitivity and specificity.
  plot_data <- results_df %>% filter(!is.na(sensitivity) & !is.na(specificity))
  
  # Create the plot.
  p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = fpr, y = sensitivity, color = factor(threshold))) +
    geom_jitter(size = 4, width = 1, height = 1) +  # Jitter points to reduce overplotting
    scale_color_manual(values = palette) +          # Custom color palette
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 100), expand = c(0, 0)) +  # Force x-axis 0–100
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 100), expand = c(0, 0)) +  # Force y-axis 0–100
    labs(x = "100 - Specificity",
       y = "Sensitivity",
       color = "AI confidence threshold (%)",
       title = cls) +
    theme_bw(base_family = "Arial") +
    theme(text = element_text(size = 9, family = "Arial"))

  
  # Return both the metrics table and the plot.
  return(list(metrics = results_df, plot = p))
}
```

### Validate model version fe_si_layers_pv6_mv11

#### Input
- *image_fragments_name_random_rois_subset_fe_si_layers_pv6_tuning.json* (fe_si_models/layers/output/qupath_random_roi/)
List of image_fragment_names with validation rois (generated with qupath/random_rois.Rmd)

```{r}
image_fragment_names <- fromJSON("~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/Projects/fe_si_models/layers/output/qupath_random_roi/image_fragments_name_random_rois_subset_fe_si_layers_pv6_tuning.json")

st_write(annotations, paste0(to_box,"Projects/fe_si_models/layers/output/validate_layers/fe_si_layers_pv6_tuning_annotations.geojson"), delete_dsn = TRUE, quiet = TRUE)  

total_images <- n_distinct(annotations$image_name)

  filter(classification %in% c("crypts", "villi")) %>%
  distinct(image_name, classification) %>%

    total_images = total_images,

        ai_output_fragment_converted <- convert_linestrings_to_polygons(ai_output_fragment)
        ai_output <- bind_rows(ai_output, ai_output_fragment_converted)
      }
    }
  }
}
```
